abstract:
For the smooth complex Fermat curve $X_m^1 \subset \mathbf{P}^2$ and Fermat hypersurface $X_m^n \subset \mathbf{P}^{n+1}$ of degree $m \ge 3$ and dimension $n \ge 1$, let $H_m := H^1(X_m^1,\mathbf{Q})$ and $K_{m,n} := H^n_{\mathrm{prim}}(X_m^n,\mathbf{Q})$. For a rational Hodge structure $V$, let $\mathsf{F}^q V \subseteq V$ denote its rational level filtration at step $q \in \mathbf{Z}$, the largest $\mathbf{Q}$-sub-Hodge structure of $V$ whose complexification vanishes in Hodge degrees $(p,r)$ with $p < q$. The Künneth tensor product gives a canonical injection $\sum_{i+j=q} \mathsf{F}^i H_m \otimes_{\mathbf{Q}} \mathsf{F}^j K_{m,n} \hookrightarrow \mathsf{F}^q(H_m \otimes_{\mathbf{Q}} K_{m,n})$ with quotient $\Delta_q(m,n)$. Across all $m \ge 3$, $n \ge 1$, and $q \in \mathbf{Z}$, we prove that $\Delta_q(m,n) 
e 0$ if and only if $mq \ge n+2$ and $2q \le n+1$. Thus for $1 \le q \le \lfloor(n+1)/2floor$ the defect vanishes only in the sub-threshold regime $m \le (n+1)/q$, whereas $\Delta_q(m,n) = 0$ whenever $q \le 0$ or $2q > n+1$. Whenever $mq \ge n+2$ and $2q \le n+1$, we construct an explicit seed pair $(A,B)$ of primitive characters $A = (1,1,m-2) \in A_{m,1}$ and $B \in A_{m,n}$ whose $(\mathbf{Z}/m\mathbf{Z})^	imes$-orbit spans a rational sub-Hodge structure in $\Delta_q(m,n)$, prove that the coordinate multiset of $B$ is invariant when the padding parameter $s$ is non-unique, and establish the permutation-orbit lower bound $\dim_{\mathbf{Q}} \Delta_q(m,n) \ge 
u_x := \varphi(m)\,|\mathfrak{S}_3 \cdot A|\,|\mathfrak{S}_{n+2} \cdot B|$ (already strict at $(m,n,q)=(5,3,1)$, where $\dim_{\mathbf{Q}} \Delta_1(5,3)=24 > 
u_x=12$). Replacing $K_{m,n}$ by $H^n(X_m^n,\mathbf{Q})$ for even $n$ leaves $\Delta_q(m,n)$ canonically unchanged, and Poincaré duality translates the criterion to Borel–Moore homology. Consequently, the level-filtration product identity in Proposition 2.2(iv) of Kang (2015), applied to $X_m^1 	imes X_m^n$ in Kang (2016), holds at step $1 \le q \le \lfloor(n+1)/2floor$ if and only if $m \le (n+1)/q$.
author: lihongmin
change_summary:
- Restricted the Künneth level-filtration equality threshold m <= (n+1)/q in the abstract and Section 1 (Summary of contributions) to 1 <= q <= floor((n+1)/2), noting that Delta_q(m,n) = 0 for all m >= 3 whenever q <= 0 or 2q > n+1 (Proposition 3.0), and noted that the permutation-orbit lower bound nu_x(m,n,q) of Theorem 1.2 is already strict at (m,n,q)=(5,3,1) (dim_Q Delta_1(5,3) = 24 > nu_x = 12).
- Updated the author line to the standard affiliation format and updated Section 1.2(2)-(3) so that [3] (hodge_conjecture_104 v7, Theorem A and Theorem 7.20) is cited for all odd degrees m >= 3 (not merely m <= 195), clarified why the proof of Proposition 6.1 in [3] for B = (2,2,2,m-5,m-1) in A_{m,3} relies on the odd-degree unit t = (m+1)/2, and added exact theorem and page locators to [4]-[11].
- Removed the word 'freely' from the (Z/mZ)^x-action on A_{m,n} in Section 2.1, clarified primitive cohomology (b_j != 0 mod m) versus full arithmetic conductor (where gcd(b_0,...,b_{n+1},m) = g > 1 gives orbit size phi(m/g), illustrated by beta = (2,2,4) in A_{8,1} fixed by t = 5, while every witness in Theorem 1.2 has a coordinate coprime to m and free orbit of size phi(m)), and formulated rational descent in Section 2.2 explicitly via the character projectors Pi_beta in Q(mu_m)[G_m^n] and the coefficient Galois group Gal(Q(mu_m)/Q) acting on K_{m,n} tensor_Q Q(mu_m).
- Corrected Section 3.4 (Example 1) on the remaining 12 dimensions of Delta_1(5,3), showing that they arise from pairing the three permutations sigma(A) in S_3 * (1,1,3) with the unit translate B' = (2,2,2,2,2) = 3 * B(0) (giving (p_5(t*sigma(A)) + p_5(t*B'))_{t=1}^4 = (1,3,1,3) in [1,3] and |E_1(5,3)| = 12 + 12 = 24).
- Included the explicit Tate twist (d_Y) = (n+1) in the Poincaré duality isomorphism PD_Y : H^{2d_Y-k}(Y,Q)(d_Y) -> H^{BM}_k(Y,Q) and in Corollary 4.1 (Delta^{BM}_p(m,n) ~= Delta_{n+1-p}(m,n)(n+1)).
- Corrected the uncompressed byte count of witness-records.jsonl.xz in Section 5 and supplement/README.md to 3,895,997 bytes (213,052 bytes compressed, enforced in verify_witnesses.py and independent_checker.py), and expanded independent_checker.py (independent-summary.json) to verify the 24-element decomposition of E_1(5,3) and to check Proposition 1.3 directly from shifted character bidegrees across 70,400 character orbits (386,560 unit evaluations).
title: The Exact Tensor-Filtration Defect on Products of a Fermat Curve and a Fermat Hypersurface
